§6Tank Modules§f

§aAdd automation, monitoring, and computer control to your tanks.§f

Up to §e10 modules§f can be installed per tank. You can filter, drain, and redstone-control a single tank all at once.

§6Tank Interface§f lets hoppers, pipes from other mods, and conduits fill and drain containers from any side. Makes the tank a drop-in replacement for any standard fluid container.

§6Tank Fluid Filter§f shows the current filter. Right-click it with a Configurator to set which fluid the tank accepts. Everything else gets rejected.

§6Tank Sensor§f checks conditions on the tank and emits a weak redstone signal when they are met. Up to 10 per tank. The GUI lets you set the sensor type and parameters like fluid level thresholds. Rotate with a wrench.

§6Tank Data Port§f requires ComputerCraft. Connects to a computer or wired modem and provides a peripheral API for programmatic tank management. All calls take at least 1 tick.

§ePS:§f Pair a Tank Sensor with a Tank Fluid Filter to build fully automatic fluid transfer setups.
